During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a mining [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] in the [[Far Xandil sector/Legends|Far Xandil sector]] was converted into a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] '''clearinghouse''', a gathering spot for pirates to trade stolen goods and sell captured crews into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]]. Originally commanded by the [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Ingan dire Stane]], the [[clearinghouse]] fell under the command of the former [[Lorrdian/Legends|Lorrdian]] slave [[Aral tukor Viest]] after she had killed Stane.
